name: hookreel
description: Interview-to-video pipeline for short vertical videos (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) for any brand with its own context profile, in four stops: /hookreel:make runs a one-message brief, auto-checked facts, a HookLab story and script approved together, one prototype scene, then the rest in one run (every scene, ElevenLabs voice with exact word times or a recording, loudness, a scored critique loop on stills, render, QA, self-critique, covers and caption). Each video gets new custom motion invented from the user's reference reels, rendered with HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP, frame = f(t)); plus photo carousels from a source post. Made by Lawrence Philemon for personal use; not for sale.
